single.rationale: Arrivent is a pre-revenue clinical-stage biopharma with rapidly deteriorating cash position ($45.5M at year-end 2025, down from $74.3M in 2024) and accelerating cash burn ($160.6M in 2025 vs $70.2M in 2024). While firmonertinib shows promising interim data in uncommon EGFR mutations with topline Phase 3 data expected mid-2026, the company faces substantial execution risk, requires significant additional capital before any potential commercialization, and carries massive contingent milestone obligations ($765M to Allist, $1.17B to Lepu Biopharma) that could severely dilute shareholders.
